_comment: The shape check-items.py and assemble-script.py read. A writer copies this to script.json and fills every empty string. kind, act, object and target are fixed by BIBLE.md; the writer's job is title, story, clue, prompt, correct, wrong1, wrong2, explanation, and the frame. Options ordered here as correct/wrong1/wrong2 are NOT the button order; assemble-script.py deals the key.

cover.title: THE LOCH NESS LOOP
cover.object: the yellow hybrid bike on the shingle at Dores

choices.object: the fork in the road above the beach

endings.object: the photo pinned on the shop wall
the phone in the open pannier on the counter
the bike on the rack of the bus

scenes.object: the yellow hybrid at the counter
scenes.target: the hire terms: when the bike is due back, what a late return costs

scenes.object: the e-bike's battery
scenes.target: which bike Shona is recommending and why (indirect: 'I'd not take the e-bike if I were you')

scenes.object: the saddle on the workstand
scenes.target: SEAT POST (the fit rule; the quick-release lever under the saddle). Photo 1: Shona's picture for the wall

scenes.object: the right-hand brake lever
scenes.target: HANDLEBARS / BRAKE LEVERS; UK: right lever = front brake; 'over the handlebars'

scenes.object: the rear derailleur
scenes.target: DERAILLEUR (the arm that moves the chain across the cogs), not CASSETTE, not CHAINRING

scenes.object: the loaded bike at the railing over the river
scenes.target: the route advice: out through Dores, keep the loch on your right, stay off the A82

scenes.object: the flat back tyre
scenes.target: WHEEL family: a puncture; the thorn is in the TYRE (not the inner tube, not the rim)

scenes.object: the tyre lever hooked under the tyre
scenes.target: KIT: the TYRE LEVERS hooked under the tyre to get it off the rim

scenes.object: the club rider's orange jersey
scenes.target: a stranger's advice: forty psi means a pinch puncture on the first pothole; Shona said sixty-five on the back

scenes.object: the chain hanging off the chainring
scenes.target: DRIVE verb: the chain COMES OFF on the climb out of Foyers (not 'has fallen', not 'has gone out')

scenes.object: the front wheel at the cattle grid
scenes.target: WHEEL family: a loose SPOKE after the cattle grid, the wheel wobbles (not the rim, not the hub)

scenes.object: the mini pump on the valve
scenes.target: KIT verb: PUMP UP to sixty with the mini pump on the valve (not 'pump until', not 'pump over')

scenes.object: the farmer's red quad bike at the gate
scenes.target: a stranger's advice: the descent to Fort Augustus is four miles and all brakes; the cafe at the top is the last one

scenes.object: the cassette on the back wheel
scenes.target: DRIVE verb: the gears keep SLIPPING under load on the long drag (not 'sliding', not 'escaping')

scenes.object: Moira's pint glass under the bar lamp
scenes.target: where you are from: Moira guesses (Dutch, then Danish); you say Switzerland; Jean asks 'whereabouts - the German bit or the French bit?' - what is Jean asking for

scenes.object: the pub window with the loch at dusk
scenes.target: where and when: Moira says from the water at first light, flat calm; Jean says the castle bay at the back of six if you must - what do both agree on. Photo 2

scenes.object: the rear brake on the bike by the pub door
scenes.target: BRAKE PADS rubbing on the rim (not the levers, not the cables); Jean fixes it with a multi-tool and sends you to Archie at the pier at six

scenes.object: Archie's hand on the tiller
scenes.target: Archie's rules aboard: sit low, don't stand, don't shout, camera below the rail till he says

scenes.object: the orange strap over the pannier rack
scenes.target: stowing the bike: strap it down by the PANNIER RACK (not the mudguard, not the kickstand)

scenes.object: the wet back and white wake, castle behind
scenes.target: the sighting: she'll go down and come up once more, further off; take the picture the second time. Photo 3

scenes.object: the gulls on the flat water
scenes.target: Archie's rules aboard: engine off, nobody talks; if the birds lift, look where they came from, not where they're going

scenes.object: the front wheel off, leaning on the thwart
scenes.target: stowing the bike: the QUICK RELEASE takes the front wheel off (not 'quick lock', not 'fast lever')

scenes.object: the neck against the sunrise
scenes.target: the sighting: a wake with no boat in front of it; count - more than twenty seconds up means it's not a seal. Photo 3

scenes.object: the bent rear mudguard
scenes.target: the rear MUDGUARD has bent in and ticks on the wheel every turn (not the pannier rack, not the chain guard). Photo 4: the castle from the path

scenes.object: the notes on the shop counter
scenes.target: the deposit: the scratch on the top tube was on the sheet already; the bent mudguard is new and costs fifteen; the kit is complete; eighty-five back
